historicalDependencyLedgerFinding.claim: 15 upstream task SHAs (S1F-REF-001, S1F-ENT-001, S1F-FLT-001, ... S1F-UIX-001) are ancestors of candidate SHA 527a3d403464806ea1d4f417c60ac3e4fa8f17d6
historicalDependencyLedgerFinding.independentVerificationResult: NOT independently confirmable in this repository as written
details: 527a3d403464806ea1d4f417c60ac3e4fa8f17d6 (the ledger's own 'Candidate Commit SHA') is neither PR #1451's headRefOid (4b4c61d9b4794d50d45fb1119788aa574f307f90) nor its mergeCommitSha (4012b10c...) per the GitHub API; it is a stale/superseded snapshot of the PR branch and is unreachable from origin/dev.
Of the 15 dependency SHAs listed in the ledger table, only f9c720fa49df888ea4761f167d16c96b64a9481f (S1F-REL-001-PREDEPLOY) is present in origin/dev history.
The other 14 listed SHAs do not exist as objects on origin (`git fetch origin <sha>` returns 'not our ref' for e.g. c022634e78ebc61aa4f107f9ff36eb74a68ef3a7).

Root cause identified for at least 2 sampled entries: the ledger recorded each dependency PR's *head* SHA (discarded by squash-merge) instead of GitHub's actual merge_commit_sha. Example: PR #1331 (S1F-DRV-001) head=048a5d328a1cb2349694157eff3b44749f7bea5c (ledger value, NOT in dev), but GitHub's merge_commit_sha=6a43f1a9afef7a41b38c24187727801c27fb2bdb IS present in origin/dev history.

A second, more serious issue found while resolving PR numbers via the GitHub API: PR numbers 1330, 1332, 1333, 1334, 1336, 1357, 1370, and 1386, cited by the ledger for 8 of the 15 dependency rows, are recorded by GitHub as state=CLOSED, merged=false (two of them, #1330 and #1332, are not even based on 'dev'). These PR numbers do not correspond to merged Stage 1 work in this repository as the ledger describes.

This finding is out of scope to fully resolve here; S1F-REL-FIN-AUD-001 (owner Codex2) is explicitly chartered to reconcile candidate/CI/merge SHA discrepancies across the release evidence. This lock does not rely on the 14-item historical ledger; it relies only on the directly reviewed, independently GitHub-verified PR #1451 dependency shown above.
